predicted_titles: Edge Intelligence and Internet of Things in Healthcare
Paving the Last Mile of Artificial Intelligence With Edge Computing

cited_details.statement: Academic research has documented trends in the advancement of edge IoT-based smart healthcare, reflecting a shift toward edge-resident computation in latency-sensitive and data-intensive applications, motivating distributed intelligence acquisition and sharing across heterogeneous devices and network domains (https://www.academia.edu/60275486/Edge_Intelligence_and_Internet_of_Things_in_Healthcare_A_Survey).
Research on edge intelligence in IoT contexts adopts a layered architectural model (https://www.academia.edu/60275486/Edge_Intelligence_and_Internet_of_Things_in_Healthcare_A_Survey).

*3.1 Edge AI.* Edge AI enables low-latency perception by processing data locally, reducing dependence on cloud infrastructure while improving system efficiency (https://www.researchgate.net/publication/333733935_Edge_Intelligence_Paving_the_Last_Mile_of_Artificial_Intelligence_With_Edge_Computing).

*3.2 Information-Centric Networking.* Research has identified the synergy between artificial intelligence methods and information-centric networking (ICN) cache management as a means to enhance user experience in distributed environments (https://www.nature.com/nature-index/topics/l4/information-centric-networking-architectures-and-technologies).

*4.1 Smart Healthcare.* The academic literature documents trends in the advancement of edge IoT-based smart healthcare, examining how edge intelligence and the IoT converge in healthcare contexts (https://www.academia.edu/60275486/Edge_Intelligence_and_Internet_of_Things_in_Healthcare_A_Survey).

*5.1 Distributed Inference and Orchestration.* Edge-intelligence systems must reconcile distributed inference with network-wide orchestration, requiring new mechanisms for workload placement, model synchronization, and resource allocation across heterogeneous devices (https://www.academia.edu/60275486/Edge_Intelligence_and_Internet_of_Things_in_Healthcare_A_Survey).

*5.2 Adaptive Caching in ICN.* Incorporating AI methods into ICN cache management raises questions about how to balance caching performance, content freshness, and computational overhead in environments where intelligence artifacts may themselves be cacheable (https://www.nature.com/nature-index/topics/l4/information-centric-networking-architectures-and-technologies).

*5.3 System Efficiency at Scale.* Edge AI is positioned to reduce dependence on cloud infrastructure while improving system efficiency, but realizing these gains at scale requires advances in model compression, hardware acceleration, and robust mechanisms for distributed training and inference (https://www.researchgate.net/publication/333733935_Edge_Intelligence_Paving_the_Last_Mile_of_Artificial_Intelligence_With_Edge_Computing).

noncited_details.claim: This local-processing capability is foundational to embedding intelligence into the network edge, allowing time-critical inferences to be drawn without round-trips to remote data centers.
